Disclosures & Legal Templates
Pre-written disclosures you can copy, email, or push to clients as needed.
📊 Results Disclaimer

Include this in proposals and discovery call follow-ups. Protects you from clients expecting guaranteed rankings or revenue.

🤖 AI Tools Disclosure

Discloses that AI tools may be used in your workflow. Recommended to include in your SOW or proposal.

🔒 Third-Party Platform Disclaimer

Protects you if Netlify, Stripe, Google, or any third-party tool changes or goes down.

♿ Accessibility Disclaimer

Web accessibility (ADA / WCAG compliance) is a legal gray area. Include this to protect against claims.

🖼️ Content Ownership Disclosure

Clarifies that stock images, fonts, and plugins may have their own licenses.

📧 Scope of Work Template (SOW)

Send this with your proposal email to set expectations before the contract is signed. Fill in the bracketed fields.

Prospects
Your outreach research workspace. Log local businesses you find, qualify them with your AI Review tool, and track who you have reached out to. Send the actual emails from your outreach tool, then mark them here.
🔎 Find businesses
Pulls real businesses from Google Places and adds new ones to your list (already-known businesses are skipped). Ones with no website get High priority automatically.
＋ Add a prospect
+ More details (optional)
Bulk import — paste a list of leads

One lead per line. Use commas: Business name, website, notes (website and notes optional). Example:
G A Public Adjusters, , Public adjuster — SEO refresh could capture claim searches

⬆ Bulk import (CSV)
Upload a CSV to add many prospects at once. The file needs a header row. Recognized columns (any order, extras ignored): business_name (required), contact_name, email, phone, website, site_status, source, priority, notes. Duplicates by business name are skipped.

Email Templates
Your outreach copy, ready to paste into your sending tool. These lead with a free site review, not a hard pitch. Fill in the brackets per business. Your CAN-SPAM footer is already included.
✉️ Warm and brief
Subject: A quick free review of your website
Hi [First Name], I came across [Business Name] while looking around at local spots, and I run a small web studio here in LA called Davis Digital Studio. I built a free tool that gives you a quick, honest review of your website, things like how fast it loads on phones, how easy it is for new customers to find you on Google, and a few simple fixes that make a difference. No catch, no signup wall, you just run it and get the results. If you're curious how [Business Name]'s site is doing, you can try it here: https://davisdigitalstudio.com Hope it's useful either way. Eric Davis Davis Digital Studio eric@davisdigitalstudio.com https://davisdigitalstudio.com 3727 W. Magnolia Blvd, PMB 1061, Burbank, CA 91505 Not interested in hearing from me again? Just reply "unsubscribe" and I'll take you off my list.
✉️ Personalized hook
Subject: Noticed something about [Business Name]'s site
Hi [First Name], I'm Eric, I run a small web studio in LA called Davis Digital Studio, and I happened to land on [Business Name]'s website. I noticed [one specific, true observation, e.g. "it loads a little slow on mobile" / "there's no easy way to see your menu on a phone"], which is a really common thing for busy small businesses and usually a quick fix. I built a free review tool that breaks this kind of stuff down in plain language, what's working, what's costing you customers, and a few simple things to improve. It's genuinely free, no signup, you just run it: https://davisdigitalstudio.com Figured it might be worth two minutes for you. Eric Davis Davis Digital Studio eric@davisdigitalstudio.com https://davisdigitalstudio.com 3727 W. Magnolia Blvd, PMB 1061, Burbank, CA 91505 Don't want emails from me? Reply "unsubscribe" and you're off the list.
💡 How to use these
Find a business, log it in Prospects, run its site through your AI Review tool, then paste a template into your sending tool and fill in the brackets. The personalized hook converts better because it references something real about their actual site. Keep it to 15 to 20 a day from your domain so your sender reputation stays healthy, and let your warm-up run for about two weeks before the first real send.
